title: Demon Biker with Dragon
description: A red-skinned demonic figure with large curved horns and ornate black armor rides a futuristic black and orange motorcycle through shallow water. A massive red and black dragon with glowing green eyes and open jaws emerges from the water beside the bike while two blonde female riders follow behind under a dark stormy sky.
prompt: A towering red demonic warrior with massive horns and spiked black armor rides a sleek futuristic motorcycle with glowing orange accents, splashing through shallow water on ancient stone. A giant red dragon with glowing green eyes and sharp teeth emerges from the water beside him. Two blonde female riders in dark armor follow on similar bikes. Dramatic dark stormy sky with embers, hellish atmosphere, highly detailed digital fantasy art.
